children: ANZ's bull at Citi says the Australian lender's improved cost control offset its slightly softer-than-expected annual revenue. Analyst Thomas Strong tells clients that ANZ's fiscal 2026 result was broadly in line, with cash earnings of 7.59 billion Australian dollars coming in just 0.2% ahead of his forecast. While net interest margin of 1.53% fell 2 basis points short of consensus, Strong points out that this was impacted by markets. Costs were A$150 million lower than the average analyst forecast and fiscal 2027 costs guidance looks in line with expectations, he adds. Citi has a last-published buy rating on the stock and a target price of A$41.00. Shares are down 1.5% at A$39.73. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
